hostname hq-core-sw-01
!
enable algorithm-type scrypt secret 9 $9$abc$def
username admin privilege 15 algorithm-type scrypt secret 9 $9$abc$def
!
ip routing
!
vlan 10
 name USERS
vlan 20
 name SERVERS
vlan 30
 name IOT-CAMERAS
vlan 40
 name GUEST
vlan 99
 name MGMT
!
interface Vlan10
 description User workstations
 ip address 10.10.10.1 255.255.255.0
!
interface Vlan20
 description Server farm
 ip address 10.10.20.1 255.255.255.0
!
interface Vlan30
 description Cameras and door controllers
 ip address 10.10.30.1 255.255.255.0
!
interface Vlan40
 description Guest wifi
 ip address 10.10.40.1 255.255.255.0
 ip access-group GUEST-IN in
!
interface Vlan99
 ip address 10.10.99.1 255.255.255.0
!
ip access-list extended GUEST-IN
 10 permit udp any host 10.10.20.53 eq domain
 20 deny ip any 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255
 30 permit ip any any
ip access-list standard MGMT-ONLY
 10 permit 10.10.99.0 0.0.0.255
!
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
ip ssh version 2
logging host 10.10.20.50
no vstack
!
snmp-server community Xk29!mon RO MGMT-ONLY
!
line vty 0 4
 access-class MGMT-ONLY in
 transport input ssh
line vty 5 15
 access-class MGMT-ONLY in
 transport input ssh
!
